purpose: development-only audit of the frozen source-transfer localization objective at truth and recovered source
comparison: At each frozen model, evaluate the same fine-sampled waveform MSE and target-FMM arrival objective at the known true source and the existing hybrid estimate. Positive estimate-minus-truth loss means the true source has a lower objective value; no search parameter or loss weight is changed.
restriction: Uses four previously inspected development events. The four source_transfer_moe_test events are excluded. These scores diagnose the objective and cannot establish independent transfer benefit.
